messages:
Maya (AM): FYI Acme demo just hit a wall during the integration test. JSON-mode + tool call path returns schema validation errors and sporadic 500s. They want this working for tomorrow's exec demo :grimacing:
Simon (SE): Can you paste the exact error + request payload? also ping @Liam and @Eva if it's infra/rate related
Maya (AM): Here's the snippet we saw in the UI (root request id 2c9a):
```
POST /v1/generate -> 500
body: {
  "model": "open-rl-16k",
  "json_mode": true,
  "tool_calls": [{"name": "extract_entities", "schema": {..}}],
  "input": "Order: #12345..."
}
error: "schema validation failed: missing required property 'customer.email'"
trace: runtime/handler:line 201
```
Liam (Infra Eng): Seeing correlated 429 spikes in the logs from that tenant. Looks like they hit the burst quota then we fallback to a slower route and some requests time out -> 500s. I can increase soft limit for Acme on staging for the demo window.
Eva (SRE): Also noticed frequent KV cache-miss patterns for repeated tool-calls which balloon latency. Suggest enabling prefix caching for that route.
Simon (SE): Schema error could be because the tool emits nullable email or returns extra wrapper object. Can you dump the tool output when invoked locally?
Maya (AM): Attaching the tool output sample from their environment: `{"entities":[{"type":"customer","email":null}]}` — so null email present. They expect our schema to accept nullable but our current JSON-mode validator rejects it.
Simon (SE): Quick workaround: disable strict JSON-mode for that route (set `strict_schema=false`) and add a post-processor in the tool to coerce null -> "" for customer.email. I'll draft the patch.
Maya (AM): Customer also asked about committed pricing if we add Dedicated for higher QPS — can someone confirm ballpark committed $/month for 8x A100 equivalent? They asked in the same thread with procurement.
Liam (Infra Eng): I'll pull committed pricing ranges and include ops-cost delta for prefix caching and increased pool. cc @Maya
security-bot: Acme SecOps submitted the SQA with KMS and VPC questions. They specifically asked: "Are model prompts/eval logs persisted on our side? Is KMS used for in-rest model weights keys?" Need a concise answer for tomorrow.
Maya (AM): For the demo we promised no persisted logs and customer-managed keys in Private mode — but they want written confirmation. Can Legal/Trust provide canned text?
Simon (SE): For immediate unblock: 1) Liam bump staging soft qps for Acme for 2 hours, 2) I push a small validator tolerance patch to accept nullable email + add coercion, 3) Maya get written confirmation from Trust on logs/KMS. That should remove both 500s and schema fail.
Eva (SRE): I'll watch the rollout and keep an eye on 500->429 cascade. If we see any error rate >3% I'll rollback traffic.
Maya (AM): Thanks — please mark action items. I will update Acme and schedule a 11:30 sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy started by Simon at 1823456805 for service json-validator (canary)
Simon (SE): Patch deployed to canary. Can everyone hit the staging route now and confirm the schema error gone?
Maya (AM): Staging run successful — no schema error and much fewer 500s after Liam's soft limit bump. Sending update to Acme and procurement.
Eva (SRE): Monitoring looks green for now, will keep the canary under watch for 30m.
Maya (AM): Closing the immediate triage. Follow-ups: pricing doc from Liam, Trust note for SecOps. I'll create a cadence doc for future demos to avoid this. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
